name: Yin-Yang! X Change Alternative
source:
Kaoru Sakurazuka is a normal young man, besides his unusually feminine features. Even his name, Kaoru, is a common name for both girls and boys. His friends don't care, and he enjoys living in a cheap apartment with his buddies Touya and Renji.

One day he feeling strangely ill, so Kaoru visits the school doctor, who is more like a crackpot chemist that enjoying creating new concoctions in the name of science. Upon his visit, Kaoru accidentally drinks a vial marked 'experimental medicine' – and the next day Kaoru, the boy, has become Kaoru, the girl! While he desperately tries to find a way to return to normal, he's forced to spend his days in his new female body.

Kaoru is surprised at the changes in his environment now that he's a girl. Everywhere he goes he's the center of attention, and it seems that everyone takes an interest in him. What strange adventures are in store for Kaoru, now that he has this new body to test-out?

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/games/p013/]JAST USA[/url]]
translation:
樱冢薰是一名普通青年，只是外貌格外秀气，颇具女性气质。就连“薰”这个名字也男女皆可使用。他的朋友对此并不在意，薰也很享受与好友冬弥、莲司一起住在廉价公寓里的生活。

一天，薰感觉身体莫名不适，便去找校医。那名校医更像个古怪的化学家，总喜欢打着科学的名义调制新药。就诊时，薰不慎喝下一瓶标有“实验药物”的液体——第二天，原本身为男孩的薰竟变成了女孩！薰拼命寻找恢复原状的方法，却只能暂时以新的女性身体度过每一天。

变成女孩后，周围环境的变化令薰大吃一惊。无论走到哪里，他都会成为众人瞩目的中心，仿佛每个人都对他产生了兴趣。拥有这副崭新的身体后，究竟会有怎样的离奇冒险等待着薰？
